summary: Iteration 84 backend regression — validated the P0 partial-commit fix (posAddPoint commit-marker + idempotent self-heal + Master Brain audit/repair/undo) AND the broader POS suite (customer-check, OTP check, redeem, return, true-duplicate). 12/12 backend tests PASS (3 iteration84_partial_commit_test.py + 9 new iteration84_pos_regression_test.py). No regression from the $set->$inc + commit_status refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: pos_ewards_routes.py is 2319 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into pos_earn.py / pos_redeem.py / pos_return.py / pos_otp.py / pos_shared.py modules to reduce cognitive load and blast radius of future changes.

pos_otp_col is instantiated locally in pos_ewards_routes.py (line 79: db['pos_otp_sessions']) rather than being centralized in database.py alongside the other _col handles. Small consistency nit — could cause drift if collection name ever changes.

posAddPoint self-heal reads _credit snapshot directly from the pending transaction — good. Suggest also asserting a schema-version field on _credit so future changes to the snapshot shape don't silently double-credit legacy pending rows.
Karix SMS is fire-and-forget and unreachable in preview; several warning log lines during test runs are infra artifacts (as noted by main agent), not code bugs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The two iteration84 test files together form the P0 regression suite: iteration84_partial_commit_test.py (happy path DB state, self-heal exactly-once, audit->repair->undo full cycle) + iteration84_pos_regression_test.py (customer-check, OTP verify, add-point happy, TRUE duplicate no double-credit, redeem OTP flow, insufficient-balance guard, returnOrder reverses points+lifetime_spend, missing-mobile 400). Run both with: python -m pytest backend/tests/iteration84_partial_commit_test.py backend/tests/iteration84_pos_regression_test.py -v — expected 12/12. Standalone Mongo cannot reproduce a real timeout, so self-heal is exercised by directly seeding a pending transaction row with the full _credit snapshot.
rca of the issue: P0 already RCA'd and fixed by main agent: bill settlement did three separate non-transactional writes (insert txn -> $set customer balance -> insert earn ledger); a mid-flow read timeout left the bill saved but uncredited AND the duplicate-guard then blocked all POS retries. Fix uses commit_status='pending'->'committed' marker + idempotent _apply_bill_credit (ledger upsert + atomic $inc balance claim gated on balance_applied) + Master Brain repair_partial_commit_bills for legacy bills. Regression test confirms exactly-once credit on self-heal, no double-credit on committed retry, and clean $inc-based aggregates on returnOrder.
